description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEOctober 1, 2025CONTACTjeffspicer4mo@gmail.comJeff Spicer Announces Campaign for Missouri House District 20“A Working Voice for Working People”Independence, MO — Lifelong Independence resident and labor leader Jeff Spicer announced today his candidacy for the Missouri House of Representatives in District 20. With nearly 30 years of experience as a heavy equipment mechanic and labor manager, Spicer is stepping forward to bring the voice of working families to Jefferson City.“I
